_comment: Function-level reachability data for the Security Agent's search_symbol_usage tool. GitHub's Dependabot/advisory API tells you a package+version is vulnerable but not reliably which function; this file is the small, honest fallback the PRD calls for (section 5, step 7) so import-level checks can be tightened to function-level without hand-waving. Verify these against the live Dependabot alerts once the repo is pushed -- advisory IDs and severities can be re-checked at https://github.com/advisories/<GHSA-id>.

pyyaml.note: yaml.load is only unsafe when called without Loader=yaml.SafeLoader
